description_en: Retrieves the list of models called for billing management
description_zh: 计费管理/获取调用模型列表
name: ModelRouterQueryCostModelList

parameters.help_en: The start time, as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time, as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The model types, separated by commas
parameters.name: model_types

parameters.help_en: Optional. Filters results by API key ID. This parameter works in conjunction with the department and requires clientId to be specified first
parameters.help_zh: 可选，按 API Key ID 过滤（与部门联动，需先指定 clientId）
parameters.name: api_key_id

parameters.help_en: Automatic aggregation. You do not need to pass this parameter. Granularity: hourly/daily. Default value: hourly
parameters.help_zh: 自动聚合，无需传入。粒度：hourly/daily，默认hourly
parameters.name: granularity

parameters.help_en: Performs a fuzzy match on the model name or code
parameters.name: search

parameters.help_en: Optional. Filters results by member IDs, separated by commas. If not specified, the department and all its members are included. If an empty value is passed, only the department is included without members
parameters.help_zh: 可选，按成员过滤（成员ID，多个用逗号分隔）。不传=部门及其全部成员；传空值=仅部门不含成员
parameters.name: member_user_ids

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return
parameters.name: max_results
